newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse first tier rebounds.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse first tier rebounds.

text.p: Investors shed last week's bearish mood on Monday and rushed to buy first-tier stocks on the Bucharest bourse, pushing up the average prices of its four listings.
Two independent indices, the VAB and the BIG, rose by 4.9 and 5.37 percent respectively from the previous session. The BIG first-tier index was up 6.74 percent to 3,144.29 points.

"Buyers refused to pay high prices for high-caps last week and managed to drive quotes down, but they were in a hurry to buy today," a trader said. "The prices they found too high last week were viewed as appropriate today."
Volumes increased to a total 2.4 million shares from 1.9 million and overall turnover added two billion lei to climb to 8.06 billion. The first tier took more than 86 percent of that level.
Three first-tier listings closed higher and one lost due to deals struck in late trading.
Antibiotice pharmaceuticals company gained 250 lei to close at 5,100 and the other firm in the pharmaceuticals sector, Terapia, ended 200 lei stronger at 6,150.
Of the first tier's two chemical plants, Azomures firmed 150 lei to 3,150, while Oltchim lost 50 lei to close at 2,350.

On the second tier, 14 of 32 listings lost ground, eight climbed, two were flat, five had no trade and three were suspended. Policolor dye maker remained the most actively traded stock. It had 700.5 million lei in turnover and closed 100 lei higher at 5,100.
